title: Perplexus
description: A Chaotic datapack that adds a corruption that brings chunks of your world into another dimension!
body:
Perplexus is a datapack that adds a corruption that brings chunks of your world into another dimension! This corruption gives mobs special abilities that the player will have to adapt to if they want to survive! Defeating these special mobs can reward you with items that have special uses that will help the player or give the player a new challenge to get even cooler items! This corruption is chaotic and unstable so be careful!

### Important
It is not recommended to add this pack to a world you plan to keep for a long time! This pack uses world generation features which means it can not be removed once added to a world and there is a chance that an update could make the pack disfunctional! Once there is an available version of this pack for the version you would like to update to, make sure it is possible to update between the versions before trying to update your world! This pack also has a chance to break some things near the edges of chunks due to moving chunks of the world between dimensions! That means redstone contraptions may break when moving between dimensions

## Even More Important
It is not recommended to add this pack to a world you plan to keep! This pack is in beta so it may break easily and some things may break further when trying to update between beta versions!
